boundaries: Never run as a default or batch-wide step in the normal Instantly/Leads flow.
May run automatically only when Leads identifies a specific technical evidence gap after lightweight official-site review and no equally strong simpler proven angle is available.
No scanner signal automatically changes lead fit, priority, compliance, send permission or outreach state.
GitHub/Chat scans use requests/scan.json or explicit workflow_dispatch; sites.txt is local-manual only.
Instantly lead/contact/campaign data is not scanner input and must not be persisted in this repository.
Accessibility findings are candidate signals, not a conformance claim.
